name: Red Wings
description: The Red Wings were an Italian youth gang based in East Harlem, active from the late 1940s until at least 1959. Their turf centered around Jefferson Park, 116th Street and Pleasant Avenue, near Benjamin Franklin High School. In 1958, seven members were charged with murder for the fatal beating of a Cuban man named Julio Ramos in Jefferson Park on Memorial Day.
